observed_behavior: Previously entered or supplied information needed again in the same process is auto-populated or selectable, except if reentry is essential, information security requires reentry, or prior entered information is no longer valid.
context: WCAG 2.2 W3C Recommendation Dec 12 2024; exact criterion level and exceptions
limitations: Same-process boundary and three exceptions matter; not a blanket ban on asking the same question in all circumstances.
